_comment: LIV-139 movement feel tuning. `player.tilesPerSec` is the authoritative player step cadence (tiles travelled per second); the logical tile position stays authoritative and only rendering interpolates. `tween` is a render-only smoothing of each tile hop shared by the player, NPCs and opponents: `intermediateFrames` sub-positions are drawn between the source and destination tile over `durationMs`.
